before.text: ‘At New Year I heard Her Old Ladyship say she wanted to settle a match with Miss Bao-qin,’ Nightingale said with a smile. ‘Why else would she be so fond of her?’

after.text: ‘Before the New Year I heard Her Old Ladyship say she wanted to settle a match with Miss Bao-qin,’ Nightingale said with a smile. ‘Why else would she be so fond of her?’

before.text: ‘Everyone calls me a fool, but you’re a bigger fool than I am,’ Bao-yu said with a laugh. ‘It was only a joke. She’s already promised to the Hanlin scholar Mei’s family. If I really were engaged to her, would you find me like this? When I swore those oaths and tried to smash this wretched thing before, didn’t you try to stop me and say I was mad? I’ve only just got better, and you start provoking me again.’

after.text: ‘Everyone calls me a fool, but you’re a bigger fool than I am,’ Bao-yu said with a laugh. ‘It was only a joke. She’s already promised to Academician Mei’s family. If I really were engaged to her, would you find me like this? When I swore those oaths and tried to smash this wretched thing before, didn’t you try to stop me and say I was mad? I’ve only just got better, and you start provoking me again.’
